name: Catch a bug: the saved total leaves out express delivery
covers: A check that fails because the app is wrong. The case carries on to its checkpoint, and the failed check says what it found instead.

steps.say: This case fails on purpose. Order Desk has a bug: it leaves express delivery out of the total it saves. The checkpoint catches it.
Type Ada Lovelace as the customer
The form says ${total}, which is right: 2 × £12.00 and £5.00 for express delivery

steps.checkpoint: The order was saved with the total the form showed

checks.label: orders.json says the order is express
orders.json has the total the form showed, ${amount(total)}

look: The last check failed, and says what it found instead: 24.00, the total without express delivery.
The two checks before it passed: one wrong value doesn't hide what is right.
